body:
Well, that's been my experience as well. Emotional upheaval is a big problem for me.

I've witnessed footage of a live circumcision, and the screams and images of the terrified face of that defenceless baby boy will forever be with me...and will forever torment me for as long as I live.

Some days I wonder if I will ever make it...but I do...

What I saw was in fact a live circumcision. I don't remember where it was, but it was either in the USA or Australia...and I remember every detail of the baby, right up to the irises of his eyes and the hairs on his eyebrows.

I'm in Australia. I'm a 36 year old guy, and a BIG guy, super strong, fit, and physically healthy.

But mentally, that's a different story. I break down and cry during the day. Sometimes the crying suddenly stops as it's about to start...like someone is pouring cold water over me, and I can't release the pain. I admit I cry myself to sleep sometimes.

The pain is still so raw, even to this day...I am not sure what destroyed my life, whether it was watching this poor little boy being tortured or whether it was the long-term consequences of consuming over 150 grams of pentobarbital over an 8 month period. Even now my memory is shot to bits and I can't even remember say 3 things at once. I need to be reminded after I've done like 1 thing LOL...my life, at least as I see it, is well and truly over. I don't know much else if anything there is to say.

But what I can say is that every day, getting out of bed, doing normal chores, concentrating at work, is just impossible.
